gold.user: As a developer, I want to retrieve a list of all available codes of conduct so that I can ensure my project adheres to community standards.
gold.ideal: The API should return a JSON array of codes of conduct, including their keys and descriptions, allowing me to choose the appropriate one for my project.

gold.user: As a project maintainer, I need to fetch the details of a specific code of conduct using its key to understand its guidelines and requirements.
gold.ideal: The API should return a detailed JSON object of the specified code of conduct, including its full text and any relevant links for further information.
